packageRules.description: Keep the exact Node 22.23.5 consumer runtime protected in CI.
Develop and test against the Knex 3 line that the peer range declares; moving to Knex 4 needs a compatibility review and a major release.
Keep the supported Knex peer range intentional; change it by hand alongside compatibility testing.
Keep CI MySQL services on the 8.4 line; Ghost and existing consumers use MySQL 8 and compatibility testing must not drift to newer server majors.
